phases.description: Establish unified CollisionResult schema and Authority Contract types.
Implement exact analytical Segment-Triangle, Triangle-Triangle, and Capsule-AABB distance solvers.
Remove try/catch swallows in AssemblyInterferenceEngine; enforce ANALYSIS_FAILED and INVALID_GEOMETRY semantics.
Bind CAM and Kinematic collision pipelines to real CAD B-Rep tessellations with chordal error bounds.
Implement zero-tunneling Swept Convex Hull pre-filter and Conservative Advancement for continuous toolpaths.
Replace mock 30mm offsets with real rigid body mesh distance queries in KinematicCollisionClearanceBridge.
Connect CollisionDetectionWorkspace directly to active document CAD models, replacing createSampleObstacleTriangles.
Integrate SHA-256 provenance hashing and canonical document JSON serialization with sorted keys.
Execute full B01-B20 benchmark qualification battery and achieve 100% pass rate.
